about: A signed line of a place's own lock stands only inside the window its key held at the epoch the line carries: the window topos gives for that epoch, the same one the ledger's authority reads. A window re-signed wider allows what is signed after it and never what was signed before, so an own lock and the ledger never disagree on a line.
